checks: Equal area at anchor phase; surface partition identity; RV+ pressure and force reproduce v11 for both time derivatives; saved Lamb field reproduced from velocity and curl of gradient; midpoint velocity/vorticity split exact on every finite profile.
limitations: Exploratory spatial controls; not causal interventions or independent replicates. Patch selection uses geometry only, but RV+ reference and late interval derive from earlier data. Area is exactly matched at phase .75, not enforced at other deformed phases. Closest mesh center may differ from requested offset; overlap reported. No significance test.
